verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers card creation, card state transitions, velocity/authorization controls, disputes, webhooks, and simulations, but contains no documentation of PIN set/reset endpoints or 3DS enrollment flows anywhere in the Core API docs. 'PCI widgets' is mentioned only as a marketing bullet with no detail on PIN management. Missing for 10: PIN set/reset API endpoints, 3DS enrollment API, any support-ticket-free credential management documentation.
